arm64.name: engine-arm64-11.18-2
arm64.for: Apple silicon, macOS 27 or later, no Rosetta
arm64.title: Apple silicon engine, engine-arm64-11.18-2
arm64.summary: Wine 11.18 development snapshot (arm64 host, ARM64EC, i386 WoW64) built from source with 30 of Hadron's Wine patches, plus FEX (x86 and x86-64 emulation inside Wine) with Hadron's 5 FEX patches, plus FreeType, libpng and GnuTLS with Nettle, GMP, libtasn1, libidn2 and libunistring, each built from its release tarball.
arm64.modified: Wine and FEX are modified: Hadron's patches listed in patches.conf were applied (git am) to the upstream commits named below, and the result was built on 21 October 2026 with the scripts in adp-engine-arm64-11.18-2-build.tar.xz. The libraries in lib/ext were built from their upstream tarballs by build-ext.sh, with GnuTLS's upstream commit 29c2027c applied; their install names were then rewritten to @loader_path, local symbols stripped, and every Mach-O file signed with Alex Parkin's Developer ID under the engine's own identifier com.alexparkin.adpmonitor.winehost.
arm64.sources: The complete corresponding source of every LGPL and GPL component listed below, the source of every other library built into lib/ext, and the scripts used to build, install and package them, are files of the same GitHub release as the engine.

x86_64.name: engine-x86_64-11.18-1
x86_64.title: Intel engine, engine-x86_64-11.18-1
x86_64.summary: Wine 11.18 development snapshot (x86_64 host, i386 and x86_64 Windows code through WoW64) built from source with 16 of Hadron's Wine patches and 3 of ours, plus FreeType and GnuTLS with Nettle, GMP and libtasn1, each built from its release tarball. Cross-compiled on an Apple silicon Mac for macOS 12.3 or later.
x86_64.modified: Wine is modified: 16 of Hadron's patches (patches.conf) and our 3 patches (patches/) were applied (patch -F0) to the upstream commit named below, and the result was built on 21 October 2026 with the scripts in adp-engine-x86_64-11.18-1-build.tar.xz. The libraries in lib/ext were cross-compiled from their upstream tarballs by build-deps.sh, with GnuTLS's upstream commit 29c2027c applied; their install names were then rewritten to @loader_path, local symbols stripped, and every Mach-O file signed with Alex Parkin's Developer ID under the engine's own identifier com.alexparkin.adpmonitor.winehost.
x86_64.sources: The complete corresponding source of every LGPL and GPL component listed below, the source of FreeType, and the scripts used to build, install and package them, are files of the same GitHub release as the engine.
